### INPUT
#### clinical input
```{r}
### clinical
clin_dat <- as.data.frame(read_tsv(file = "clinical.input.txt", col_names = T))
sur_dat <- as.data.frame(clin_dat) %>% 
  dplyr::select("Sample", "OS_5year", "Death_5year", "DFS_5year", "Relapse_Death_5year") %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(`OS_5year` = as.numeric(`OS_5year`),
                `Death_5year` = as.numeric(`Death_5year`),
                `DFS_5year` = as.numeric(`DFS_5year`),
                `Relapse_Death_5year` = as.numeric(`Relapse_Death_5year`)) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(sur_os = survival::Surv(`OS_5year`, `Death_5year` == 1),
                sur_dfs = survival::Surv(`DFS_5year`, `Relapse_Death_5year` == 1)) %>% 
  dplyr::select("Sample", "sur_os", "sur_dfs")
rownames(sur_dat) <- sur_dat$Sample

## therapy
chemo_dat_01 <- as.data.frame(read.table(file = "chemotherapy.csv", sep=",",header=T))

### CMOS
CMOS <- read.table("cmos_subgroups.txt", sep="\t", header=T)
clin_dat <- merge(clin_dat, CMOS, by="Sample",all.x=T)


clin_dat <- clin_dat %>% 
  dplyr::transmute(Sample = Sample,
                   Gender = ifelse(Gender == "Female", 0, ifelse(Gender == "Male", 1, NA)),
                   Age = as.numeric(Age),
                   `TNM_Stage` = as.numeric(factor(`Stage`, levels = c("I", "II", "III", "IV"), labels = c("I", "II", "III", "IV"))),
                   `Stage1` = ifelse(`Stage` %in% c("I"), 1, 0),
                   `Stage2` = ifelse(`Stage` %in% c("II"), 1, 0),
                   `Stage3` = ifelse(`Stage` %in% c("III"), 1, 0),
                   `Stage4` = ifelse(`Stage` %in% c("IV"), 1, 0),
                   `Left_Colon` = ifelse(`Location_3group` == "Left_colon", 1, 0),
                   `Right_Colon` = ifelse(`Location_3group` == "Right_colon", 1, 0),
                   `Rectum` = ifelse(`Location_3group` == "Rectum", 1, 0),
                   `Tumor_Left_Colon` = ifelse(`Location_3group` == "Left_colon", 1, 0),
                   `Tumor_Right_Colon` = ifelse(`Location_3group` == "Right_colon", 1, 0),
                   `Tumor_Rectum` = ifelse(`Location_3group` == "Rectum", 1, 0),
                   `CMS1` = ifelse(`Final_CMS` %in% c("CMS1"), 1, 0),
                   `CMS2` = ifelse(`Final_CMS` %in% c("CMS2"), 1, 0),
                   `CMS3` = ifelse(`Final_CMS` %in% c("CMS3"), 1, 0),
                   `CMS4` = ifelse(`Final_CMS` %in% c("CMS4"), 1, 0),
                   `CMOS_all` = as.numeric(factor(`CMOS`, levels = c("CMOS1", "CMOS2", "CMOS3", "CMOS4"), labels = c("CMOS1", "CMOS2", "CMOS3", "CMOS4"))),
                   `CMOS1` = ifelse(`CMOS` %in% c("CMOS1"), 1, ifelse(is.na(`CMOS`),NA,0)),
                   `CMOS2` = ifelse(`CMOS` %in% c("CMOS2"), 1, ifelse(is.na(`CMOS`),NA,0)),
                   `CMOS3` = ifelse(`CMOS` %in% c("CMOS3"), 1, ifelse(is.na(`CMOS`),NA,0)),
                   `CMOS4` = ifelse(`CMOS` %in% c("CMOS4"), 1, ifelse(is.na(`CMOS`),NA,0)),
                   Hypermutation = ifelse(`Hypermutated` %in% c("hyper"), 1, 0),
                   `MSS` = ifelse(`GenomicSubtype2025` %in% c("MSS"), 1, 0),
                   `POLE` = ifelse(`GenomicSubtype2025` %in% c("POLE"), 1, 0),
                   `MSI` = ifelse(`GenomicSubtype2025` %in% c("MSI"), 1, 0),
                   TMB = as.numeric(TMB),
                   PGA = as.numeric(`PGA`),
                   `WGD_Status` = ifelse(`WGD_status` %in% c("WGD"), 1, 0),
                   `Chromothripsis` = ifelse(`Chromothripsis` %in% c("Yes"), 1, 0),
                   SVcount = as.numeric(SVcount),
                   `CIMP_Status` = ifelse(`CIMP_status` %in% c("CIMP"), 1, 0),
                   `Epimutation_Burden` = as.numeric(`Epimutation_burden`)
                   )

clin_dat <- clin_dat %>%
  left_join(chemo_dat_01[,c("Sample","chemotherapy")], by="Sample")
rownames(clin_dat) <- clin_dat$Sample

save(sur_dat, clin_dat, file = "01.clindata_input.RData")
```

#### protein input
```{r}

################# protein ###
pro_dat <- as.data.frame(read_tsv(file = "tumor_protein.txt", col_names = T))

pro_gene_match_tab <- as.data.frame(read_tsv(file = "proteinName.txt", col_names = T))
pro_dat <- pro_dat %>% 
  dplyr::left_join(pro_gene_match_tab[, c("Gene", "Protein")], by = c("protein" = "Protein")) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(is.na(`Gene`) == F)

pro_diff <- read.table("protein_diff.txt",sep="\t",header=T)

### MAD filtering 
############# find proteins with max MAD variation for each gene
mad_select_tab <- cbind(row_name = rownames(pro_dat),
                        mad = MatrixGenerics::rowMads(as.matrix(pro_dat[,2:(ncol(pro_dat)-1)])),
                        pro = pro_dat$protein,
                        gene = pro_dat$Gene
                        ) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  group_by(gene) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(mad == max(mad)) %>% 
  ungroup()

pro_dat <- pro_dat[mad_select_tab$row_name, ]
rownames(pro_dat) <- pro_dat$Gene
pro_dat <- pro_dat %>% 
  dplyr::select(-"protein", -"Gene") %>% 
  t() %>% 
  as.data.frame()
pro_dat <- log2(pro_dat + 1)   #########   log2 transformed ###############
pro_dat <- pro_dat %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(Sample = rownames(pro_dat))
rm(pro_gene_match_tab, mad_select_tab) 
colnames(pro_dat)[1:(ncol(pro_dat)-1)] <- str_c(colnames(pro_dat)[1:(ncol(pro_dat)-1)], "_pro", sep = "")
colnames(pro_dat) <- str_replace_all(colnames(pro_dat), pattern = "-", replacement = "_")

save(pro_dat, pro_diff, file = "01.protein.RData")


```

### FUNCTIONS
#### dfs uni cox function
```{r}
dfs_uni_cox <- function(tab_4_dfs_cox, dfs_covariates, cox_results_tsv, cox_results_rdata, model="sur_dfs") {
  
  univ_formulas <- sapply(dfs_covariates, function(x) {
    as.formula(paste(model," ~", x))
  })
  
  
  univ_models <- lapply(univ_formulas, function(x) {
    tryCatch({
      coxph(x, data = tab_4_dfs_cox)
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning(paste("Failed to fit model for", deparse(x), "\nError:", e$message))
      return(NULL)
    })
  })
  
  valid_models <- !sapply(univ_models, is.null)
  univ_models <- univ_models[valid_models]
  univ_formulas <- univ_formulas[valid_models]
  
  univ_results <- lapply(univ_models, function(x) {
    tryCatch({
      x_summary <- summary(x)
      
      p_value <- signif(x_summary$coefficients[1, 5], digits = 4)
      wald_test <- signif(x_summary$wald["test"], digits = 4)
      beta <- signif(x_summary$coefficients[1, 1], digits = 4)  
      HR <- signif(x_summary$coefficients[1, 2], digits = 4)    
      HR_conf_lower <- signif(x_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"], 4)
      HR_conf_upper <- signif(x_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"], 4)
      
      res <- c(
        beta = beta,
        HR = HR,
        HR_lower_95 = HR_conf_lower,
        HR_upper_95 = HR_conf_upper,
        wald_test = wald_test,
        p_value = p_value
      )
      
      return(res)
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning(paste("Failed to extract results for model:", deparse(x$call)))
      return(rep(NA, 6)) 
    })
  })
  
  cox_res <- t(as.data.frame(univ_results, check.names = FALSE))
  cox_res <- as.data.frame(cox_res)
  
  cox_res <- cox_res %>%
    mutate(factor = as.character(rownames(cox_res)))
  
  save(cox_res, univ_models, univ_formulas, dfs_covariates, file = cox_results_rdata)
  write.table(cox_res, file = cox_results_tsv, quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, sep = "\t")
  
  return(cox_res)
}
save(dfs_uni_cox, file = "01.dfs_uni.cox.Rdata")


```
#### os uni cox function
```{r}
os_uni_cox <- function(tab_4_os_cox, os_covariates, cox_results_tsv, cox_results_rdata,model="sur_os") {

  
  univ_os_formulas <- sapply(os_covariates,function(x) as.formula(paste(model,' ~ ', x)))
  
  univ_os_models <- lapply(univ_os_formulas, function(x) {
    tryCatch({
      coxph(x, data = tab_4_os_cox)
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning(paste("Failed to fit model for", deparse(x), "\nError:", e$message))
      return(NULL)
    })
  })
  
  univ_os_models <- univ_os_models[!sapply(univ_os_models, is.null)]
  univ_os_formulas <- univ_os_formulas[!sapply(univ_os_models, is.null)]
  
  univ_os_results <- lapply(univ_os_models, function(x) {
    tryCatch({
      x_summary <- summary(x)
      p.value <- signif(x_summary$coef[1, 5], digits = 4)
      wald.test <- signif(x_summary$wald["test"], digits = 4)
      beta <- signif(x_summary$coef[1, 1], digits = 4)  # coeficient beta
      HR <- signif(x_summary$coef[1, 2], digits = 4)    # exp(beta)
      HR.confint.lower <- signif(x_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"], 4)
      HR.confint.upper <- signif(x_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"], 4)
      res <- c(beta, HR, HR.confint.lower, HR.confint.upper, wald.test, p.value)
      names(res) <- c("beta", "HR", "HR_lower_95", "HR_upper_95", "wald.test", "p.value")
      return(res)
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning(paste("Failed to extract results for model:", deparse(x$call)))
      return(rep(NA, 6))  
    })
  })
  
  cox_os_res <- t(as.data.frame(univ_os_results, check.names = FALSE))
  cox_os_res <- as.data.frame(cox_os_res)
  cox_os_res <- cox_os_res %>%
    mutate(factor = as.character(rownames(cox_os_res)))
  
  save(os_covariates, cox_os_res, univ_os_models, univ_os_formulas, univ_os_results,file = cox_results_rdata)
  write.table(cox_os_res,file = cox_results_tsv,quote = FALSE,row.names = FALSE,sep = "\t")
 
  return(cox_os_res)
}

save(os_uni_cox, file = "os_uni.cox.Rdata")


```

#### dfs multi cox function
```{r}

dfs_multi_cox <- function(tab_4_dfs_cox, dfs_covariates, fixed_covariates=c("TNM_Stage", "Age", "Tumor_Left_Colon", "Tumor_Right_Colon", "Tumor_Rectum"), cox_results_tsv, cox_results_rdata, model="sur_dfs") {
 

  multv_formulas <- sapply(dfs_covariates, function(x) {
    as.formula(paste(model," ~ ", x, " + ", paste(fixed_covariates, collapse = " + ")))
  })
  
  multv_models <- lapply(multv_formulas, function(x) {
    tryCatch({
      coxph(x, data = tab_4_dfs_cox)
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning(paste("Failed to fit model for", deparse(x), "\nError:", e$message))
      return(NULL)
    })
  })
  
  valid_models <- !sapply(multv_models, is.null)
  multv_models <- multv_models[valid_models]
  multv_formulas <- multv_formulas[valid_models]
  
  multv_results <- lapply(multv_models, function(x) {
    tryCatch({
      x_summary <- summary(x)
      p.value <- signif(x_summary$coef[1, 5], digits = 4)
      wald.test <- signif(x_summary$wald["test"], digits = 4)
      beta <- signif(x_summary$coef[1, 1], digits = 4)  
      HR <- signif(x_summary$coef[1, 2], digits = 4)  
      HR.confint.lower <- signif(x_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"], 4)
      HR.confint.upper <- signif(x_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"], 4)
      
      res <- c(
        beta, HR, HR.confint.lower, HR.confint.upper, 
        wald.test, p.value
      )
      names(res) <- c(
        "beta", "HR", "HR_lower_95", "HR_upper_95", 
        "wald.test", "p.value"
      )
      return(res)
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning(paste("Failed to extract results for model:", deparse(x$call)))
      return(rep(NA, 6)) 
    })
  })
  
  multi_cox_res <- t(as.data.frame(multv_results, check.names = FALSE))
  multi_cox_res <- as.data.frame(multi_cox_res)
  multi_cox_res <- multi_cox_res %>%
    mutate(factor = as.character(rownames(multi_cox_res)))
  
  save(multi_cox_res, multv_models, multv_formulas, dfs_covariates, file = cox_results_rdata)
  
  write.table(multi_cox_res, file = cox_results_tsv, quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, sep = "\t")
  
  return(multi_cox_res)
}

save(dfs_multi_cox, file = "01.dfs_multi.cox.Rdata")

```

#### os multi cox function
```{r}

os_multi_cox <- function(tab_4_os_cox, os_covariates, fixed_covariates=c("TNM_Stage", "Age", "Tumor_Left_Colon", "Tumor_Right_Colon", "Tumor_Rectum"), cox_results_tsv, cox_results_rdata,model="sur_os") {
  
  multv_os_formulas <- sapply(os_covariates, function(x) {
    as.formula(paste(model,"~ ", x, " + ", paste(fixed_covariates, collapse = " + ")))
  })
  
  
  multv_os_models <- lapply(multv_os_formulas, function(x) {
    tryCatch({
      coxph(x, data = tab_4_os_cox)
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning(paste("Failed to fit model for", deparse(x), "\nError:", e$message))
      return(NULL)
    })
  })
  
  
  valid_models <- !sapply(multv_os_models, is.null)
  multv_os_models <- multv_os_models[valid_models]
  multv_os_formulas <- multv_os_formulas[valid_models]
  
  
  multv_os_results <- lapply(multv_os_models, function(x) {
    tryCatch({
      x_summary <- summary(x)
      
      p.value <- signif(x_summary$coef[1, 5], digits = 4)
      wald.test <- signif(x_summary$wald["test"], digits = 4)
      beta <- signif(x_summary$coef[1, 1], digits = 4)  
      HR <- signif(x_summary$coef[1, 2], digits = 4)    
      HR.confint.lower <- signif(x_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"], 4)
      HR.confint.upper <- signif(x_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"], 4)
      
      res <- c(beta, HR, HR.confint.lower, HR.confint.upper, wald.test, p.value)
      names(res) <- c("beta", "HR", "HR_lower_95", "HR_upper_95", "wald.test", "p.value")
      return(res)
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning(paste("Failed to extract results for model:", deparse(x$call)))
      return(rep(NA, 6))  
    })
  })
  
  
  multv_cox_os_res <- t(as.data.frame(multv_os_results, check.names = FALSE))
  multv_cox_os_res <- as.data.frame(multv_cox_os_res)
  multv_cox_os_res <- multv_cox_os_res %>%
    mutate(factor = as.character(rownames(multv_cox_os_res)))
  
  
  save(os_covariates, multv_cox_os_res, multv_os_models, multv_os_formulas, multv_os_results,file = cox_results_rdata)
  write.table(multv_cox_os_res, file = cox_results_tsv, quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, sep = "\t")
  
  
  return(multv_cox_os_res)
}

save(os_multi_cox, file = "os_multi.cox.Rdata")
```

#### dfs & os uni_multi functions packing
```{r}
run_survival_analysis <- function(phos_data, clin_dat=clin_dat, sur_dat=sur_dat, patient_id= patient_id, output_prefix = "02.05NA_phos") {
   
  # Prepare DFS data
  tab_4_dfs_cox <- clin_dat[all_patient_id,] %>% 
    inner_join(phos_data, by = "Sample") %>% 
    inner_join(sur_dat[, c("Sample", "sur_dfs")], by = "Sample") 
  
  colnames(tab_4_dfs_cox) <- gsub("-", "_", colnames(tab_4_dfs_cox))  
  colnames(tab_4_dfs_cox) <- gsub("/", "_", colnames(tab_4_dfs_cox))  
  
  dfs_covariates <- colnames(tab_4_dfs_cox[,23:ncol(tab_4_dfs_cox)-1])
  
  # DFS Univariate Cox
  dfs_uni_tsv <- paste0(output_prefix, ".univariate.dfs.cox.phosphorylation.tsv")
  dfs_uni_rdata <- paste0(output_prefix, ".univariate.dfs.cox.phosphorylation.RData")
  dfs_results_uni <- dfs_uni_cox(
    tab_4_dfs_cox = tab_4_dfs_cox,
    dfs_covariates = dfs_covariates,
    cox_results_tsv = dfs_uni_tsv,
    cox_results_rdata = dfs_uni_rdata
  )
  
  # DFS Multivariate Cox
  dfs_multi_tsv <- paste0(output_prefix, ".multivariate.dfs.cox.phosphorylation.tsv")
  dfs_multi_rdata <- paste0(output_prefix, ".multivariate.dfs.cox.phosphorylation.RData")
  dfs_results_multi <- dfs_multi_cox(
    tab_4_dfs_cox = tab_4_dfs_cox,
    dfs_covariates = dfs_covariates,
    cox_results_tsv = dfs_multi_tsv,
    cox_results_rdata = dfs_multi_rdata
  )
  
  # 2. OS (Overall Survival) Analysis -------------------------------------
  
  # Prepare OS data (with numeric conversion)
  tab_4_os_cox <- clin_dat[all_patient_id,] %>%
    inner_join(phos_data, by = "Sample") %>% 
    inner_join(sur_dat[, c("Sample", "sur_os")], by = "Sample") 

  colnames(tab_4_os_cox) <- gsub("-", "_", colnames(tab_4_os_cox))  
  colnames(tab_4_os_cox) <- gsub("/", "_", colnames(tab_4_os_cox))  
  
  os_covariates <- colnames(tab_4_os_cox[,23:ncol(tab_4_os_cox)-1])
  
  # OS Univariate Cox
  os_uni_tsv <- paste0(output_prefix, ".univariate.os.cox.phosphorylation.tsv")
  os_uni_rdata <- paste0(output_prefix, ".univariate.os.cox.phosphorylation.RData")
  os_results_uni <- os_uni_cox(
    tab_4_os_cox = tab_4_os_cox,
    os_covariates = os_covariates,
    cox_results_tsv = os_uni_tsv,
    cox_results_rdata = os_uni_rdata
  )
  
  # OS Multivariate Cox
  os_multi_tsv <- paste0(output_prefix, ".multivariate.os.cox.phosphorylation.tsv")
  os_multi_rdata <- paste0(output_prefix, ".multivariate.os.cox.phosphorylation.RData")
  os_results_multi <- os_multi_cox(
    tab_4_os_cox = tab_4_os_cox,
    os_covariates = os_covariates,
    cox_results_tsv = os_multi_tsv,
    cox_results_rdata = os_multi_rdata
  )
  
  # Return results (optional)
  list(
    dfs_uni = dfs_results_uni,
    dfs_multi = dfs_results_multi,
    os_uni = os_results_uni,
    os_multi = os_results_multi
  )
}

save(run_survival_analysis, file="01.run_cox.function.Rdata")
```

##### protein diff results & Top 50%
```{r}
load(file = "protein.RData")
load(file="univariate.os.cox.protein.RData")
load(file="multivariate.os.cox.protein.RData")
rm(multv_os_models,multv_os_formulas,univ_os_formulas,univ_os_models,os_covariates,multv_os_results,univ_os_results)
load(file="univariate.dfs.cox.protein.RData")
load(file="multivariate.dfs.cox.protein.RData")
rm(multv_formulas, multv_models,univ_formulas,univ_models,dfs_covariates)
### diff
pro_diff_formatted <- pro_diff %>%
  mutate(match_id=paste0(Gene,"_pro")) %>%
  mutate(match_id=gsub("-","_",match_id)) %>%
  mutate(match_id=gsub("/","_",match_id)) %>%
  filter(Gene!="")

#### Top 50%
colnames(pro_dat) <- gsub("/","_",colnames(pro_dat))
pro_mean <- pro_dat %>%
  select(-Sample) %>%
  colMeans()

pro_mean_df <- data.frame(
  Gene = names(pro_mean),
  pro_mean = as.numeric(pro_mean)
)

median_mean <- median(pro_mean_df$pro_mean)

pro_mean_df <- pro_mean_df %>% 
  mutate(group = ifelse(pro_mean > median_mean,"Top50%","."))

## merge
pro_diff_formatted_top50 <- merge(pro_diff_formatted, pro_mean_df, by.x="match_id",by.y="Gene", all=T)

cox_res_match <- merge( cox_res, pro_diff_formatted_top50[,c("wilcoxtest_log2FC","wilcox_FDR","Regulated","match_id","group")], by.y="match_id",by.x="factor",all.x=T)

cox_os_res_match <- merge(cox_os_res, pro_diff_formatted_top50[,c("wilcoxtest_log2FC","wilcox_FDR","Regulated","match_id","group")], by.y="match_id",by.x="factor",all.x=T)

multi_cox_res_match <- merge(multi_cox_res, pro_diff_formatted_top50[,c("wilcoxtest_log2FC","wilcox_FDR","Regulated","match_id","group")], by.y="match_id",by.x="factor",all.x=T)

multi_cox_os_res_match <- merge(multv_cox_os_res, pro_diff_formatted_top50[,c("wilcoxtest_log2FC","wilcox_FDR","Regulated","match_id","group")], by.y="match_id",by.x="factor",all.x=T)

#### save results
write.table(cox_res_match, "univariate.dfs.cox.protein.diff.tsv", sep="\t", row.names = F, quote=F)

write.table(cox_os_res_match, "univariate.os.cox.protein.diff.tsv", sep="\t", row.names = F, quote=F)

write.table(multi_cox_res_match, "multivariate.dfs.cox.protein.diff.tsv", sep="\t", row.names = F, quote=F)

write.table(multi_cox_os_res_match, "multivariate.os.cox.protein.diff.tsv", sep="\t", row.names = F, quote=F)
```

##### RNA diff and top50%
```{r}
load(file = "RNA_FPKM.RData")
load(file="02.univariate.dfs.cox.RNA.RData")
load(file="02.multivariate.dfs.cox.RNA.RData")
rm(multv_formulas, multv_models,univ_formulas,univ_models,dfs_covariates)
load(file="02.univariate.os.cox.RNA.RData")
load(file="02.multivariate.os.cox.RNA.RData")
rm(multv_os_models,multv_os_formulas,univ_os_formulas,univ_os_models,os_covariates,multv_os_results,univ_os_results)
gene_id <- read.table("human.gene2symbol_unique_biotype.txt",sep="\t",header=T)

### input formatted


df_formatted <- function(factor) {
  factor <- gsub("/","_",factor)
  factor <- gsub("-","_",factor)
  factor <- gsub(".","_",factor,fixed = T)
  return(factor)
}

colnames(exp_dat) <- df_formatted(colnames(exp_dat))
cox_res$factor  <- df_formatted(cox_res$factor)
cox_os_res$factor  <- df_formatted(cox_os_res$factor)
multi_cox_res$factor  <- df_formatted(multi_cox_res$factor)
multv_cox_os_res$factor  <- df_formatted(multv_cox_os_res$factor)

exp_diff_1 <- merge(exp_diff,gene_id[,c("GeneID","Symbol")], by.x="ENTREZID",by.y="GeneID")
### diff
exp_diff_formatted <- exp_diff_1 %>%
  filter(Symbol!="") %>%
  mutate(match_id=paste0(Symbol,"_exp")) %>%
  mutate(match_id=gsub("-","_",match_id)) %>%
  mutate(match_id=gsub("/","_",match_id)) 

#### Top 50%
exp_mean <- exp_dat %>%
  select(-Sample) %>%
  colMeans()

exp_mean_df <- data.frame(
  Gene = names(exp_mean),
  exp_mean = as.numeric(exp_mean),
  check.names=F
)

median_mean <- median(exp_mean_df$exp_mean)

exp_mean_df <- exp_mean_df %>% 
  mutate(group = ifelse(exp_mean > median_mean,"Top50%","."))

## merge
exp_diff_formatted_top50 <- merge(exp_diff_formatted, exp_mean_df, by.x="match_id",by.y="Gene", all=T)

cox_res_match <- merge(cox_res, exp_diff_formatted_top50[,c("log2FoldChange.Tumor.Normal.","Padj","Up.Down.Regulation","match_id","group")], by.y="match_id",by.x="factor",all.x=T)

cox_os_res_match <- merge(cox_os_res, exp_diff_formatted_top50[,c("log2FoldChange.Tumor.Normal.","Padj","Up.Down.Regulation","match_id","group")], by.y="match_id",by.x="factor",all.x=T)

multi_cox_res_match <- merge(multi_cox_res, exp_diff_formatted_top50[,c("log2FoldChange.Tumor.Normal.","Padj","Up.Down.Regulation","match_id","group")], by.y="match_id",by.x="factor",all.x=T)

multi_cox_os_res_match <- merge(multv_cox_os_res, exp_diff_formatted_top50[,c("log2FoldChange.Tumor.Normal.","Padj","Up.Down.Regulation","match_id","group")], by.y="match_id",by.x="factor",all.x=T)

#### save results
write.table(cox_res_match, "02.univariate.dfs.cox.RNA.diff.tsv", sep="\t", row.names = F, quote=F)

write.table(cox_os_res_match, "02.univariate.os.cox.RNA.diff.tsv", sep="\t", row.names = F, quote=F)

write.table(multi_cox_res_match, "02.multivariate.dfs.cox.RNA.diff.tsv", sep="\t", row.names = F, quote=F)

write.table(multi_cox_os_res_match, "02.multivariate.os.cox.RNA.diff.tsv", sep="\t", row.names = F, quote=F)

```
